description.zh_cn: 点击一个可见目标；x、y 必须提供，target_description 可选。
description.en_us: Tap a visible target; x and y are required, while target_description is optional.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - click(target_description?, x, y): 点击可见目标；x/y 是 required 的 0..1000 相对坐标，target_description 用于补充 grounding。
prompt_guide.en_us: - click(target_description?, x, y): Tap a visible target; x/y are required 0..1000 relative coordinates, and target_description is an optional grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 可选。要点击的目标描述，用于补充 grounding。
description.en_us: Optional. Description of the target to tap, used as a grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 点击位置的 required 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the tap target; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 点击位置的 required 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the tap target; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 长按一个目标。
description.en_us: Long-press a target.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - long_press(target_description?, x, y): 长按目标；x/y 是 required 的 0..1000 相对坐标，target_description 用于补充 grounding。
prompt_guide.en_us: - long_press(target_description?, x, y): Long-press a target; x/y are required 0..1000 relative coordinates, and target_description is an optional grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 可选。要长按的目标描述，用于补充 grounding。
description.en_us: Optional. Description of the target to long-press, used as a grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 长按位置的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the long press; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 长按位置的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the long press; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 长按时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Long-press duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 向一个可见输入目标输入文本；text、x、y 必须提供，target_description 可选。
description.en_us: Type text into a visible input target; text, x, and y are required, while target_description is optional.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - input_text(target_description?, text, x, y): 向输入框输入；text、x/y 是 required，target_description 用于补充 grounding。
prompt_guide.en_us: - input_text(target_description?, text, x, y): Type into an input field; text and x/y are required, and target_description is an optional grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 可选。目标输入框描述，用于补充 grounding。
description.en_us: Optional. Description of the input target, used as a grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 要输入的文本内容。
description.en_us: Text content to type.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 目标输入框中心的 required 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the input target center; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 目标输入框中心的 required 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Required 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the input target center; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 在屏幕或可滚动区域内按方向滑动。
description.en_us: Swipe in a direction on the screen or inside a scrollable region.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - swipe(target_description?, direction, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration_ms?): 在屏幕或指定可滚动区域内滑动；direction 和 x1/y1/x2/y2 必须提供，target_description 用于补充 grounding。
prompt_guide.en_us: - swipe(target_description?, direction, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration_ms?): Swipe on the screen or a target scrollable region; direction and x1/y1/x2/y2 are required, and target_description is an optional grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 可选。本次滑动想浏览或定位的目标描述，用于补充 grounding。
description.en_us: Optional. Description of what this swipe action is trying to browse or locate, used as a grounding hint.

description.zh_cn: 滑动方向。
description.en_us: Swipe direction.

description.zh_cn: 可选。滑动锚点的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；不提供时使用安全兜底区域。
description.en_us: Optional 0..1000 relative swipe anchor X coordinate; when omitted, the runtime uses a safe fallback region.

description.zh_cn: 可选。滑动锚点的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；不提供时使用安全兜底区域。
description.en_us: Optional 0..1000 relative swipe anchor Y coordinate; when omitted, the runtime uses a safe fallback region.

description.zh_cn: 可选。滑动距离，使用 0..1000 相对坐标尺度。
description.en_us: Optional swipe distance using the 0..1000 relative coordinate scale.

description.zh_cn: 滑动起点的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Start 0..1000 relative X coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动起点的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: Start 0..1000 relative Y coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动终点的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: End 0..1000 relative X coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动终点的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标；执行前会解码为屏幕绝对像素。
description.en_us: End 0..1000 relative Y coordinate; decoded to absolute screen pixels before execution.

description.zh_cn: 滑动时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Swipe duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 打开指定应用。
description.en_us: Open a specific app.

description.zh_cn: 目标应用的 Android package name。
description.en_us: Android package name of the target app.

description.zh_cn: 按一个系统导航键；Enter 可选定目标输入框。
description.en_us: Press one system navigation key; Enter may target a specific input field.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - press_key(key, target_description?, x?, y?): 按系统导航键；key 只能是 back、home 或 enter。
prompt_guide.en_us: - press_key(key, target_description?, x?, y?): Press a system navigation key; key must be back, home, or enter.

description.zh_cn: 系统键名称。
description.en_us: System key name.

description.zh_cn: 可选。Enter 目标输入框描述。
description.en_us: Optional description of the input field targeted by Enter.

description.zh_cn: 可选。Enter 目标输入框的 Android resource-id。
description.en_us: Optional Android resource-id of the input field targeted by Enter.

description.zh_cn: 可选。Enter 目标输入框中心的 0..1000 相对 X 坐标。
description.en_us: Optional 0..1000 relative X coordinate of the input field targeted by Enter.

description.zh_cn: 可选。Enter 目标输入框中心的 0..1000 相对 Y 坐标。
description.en_us: Optional 0..1000 relative Y coordinate of the input field targeted by Enter.

description.zh_cn: 等待页面加载、动画或外部状态变化。
description.en_us: Wait for page loading, animation, or external state changes.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - wait(duration_ms, condition?, target_description?): 等待页面加载或条件满足；duration_ms 毫秒，condition 可选 text_present、text_absent、screen_changed，文字条件必须附带 target_description。
prompt_guide.en_us: - wait(duration_ms, condition?, target_description?): Wait for page loading or conditions; duration_ms in milliseconds, condition optionally text_present, text_absent, screen_changed, text conditions require target_description.

description.zh_cn: 等待时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Wait duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 可选等待条件；可为 text_present、text_absent 或 screen_changed。
description.en_us: Optional wait condition; can be text_present, text_absent, or screen_changed.

description.zh_cn: 可选。当 condition 为 text_present 或 text_absent 时，指定要等待出现或消失的目标文本描述。
description.en_us: Optional target text description to wait for appearance or disappearance when condition is text_present or text_absent.

description.zh_cn: 在指定区域内按方向连续滚动并采集多屏文本内容。
description.en_us: Scroll continuously in a specified region along a direction to collect multi-page text content.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - collect_screen(direction, x1, y1, x2, y2, max_pages?, max_items?, ocr?): 在指定区域内沿 direction（down 阅读后页/up 阅读前页）滚动采集多屏文本；区域坐标全屏 0..1000，max_pages 默认 5（1..20），max_items 默认 100（1..200），ocr 可选端侧识别。
prompt_guide.en_us: - collect_screen(direction, x1, y1, x2, y2, max_pages?, max_items?, ocr?): Scroll in region along direction (down for next pages/up for previous pages) to collect multi-page text; coordinates in 0..1000, max_pages default 5 (1..20), max_items default 100 (1..200), ocr optional on-device recognition.

description.zh_cn: 滚动阅读方向；down 为向后阅读（手指向上滑），up 为向前阅读（手指向下滑）。
description.en_us: Scroll reading direction; down reads forward/later content (fingers scroll up), up reads backward/earlier content (fingers scroll down).

description.zh_cn: 采集区域左边缘的全屏 0..1000 相对坐标。
description.en_us: Left edge of collection region in full-screen 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 采集区域上边缘的全屏 0..1000 相对坐标。
description.en_us: Top edge of collection region in full-screen 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 采集区域右边缘的全屏 0..1000 相对坐标。
description.en_us: Right edge of collection region in full-screen 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 采集区域下边缘的全屏 0..1000 相对坐标。
description.en_us: Bottom edge of collection region in full-screen 0..1000 relative coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 最多扫描页数，默认 5，范围 1..20。
description.en_us: Maximum pages to scan, default 5, range 1..20.

description.zh_cn: 最多收集文本条目数，默认 100，范围 1..200。
description.en_us: Maximum items to collect, default 100, range 1..200.

description.zh_cn: 是否启用端侧 OCR 辅助提取未暴露无障碍文本的项，默认 false。
description.en_us: Whether to enable on-device OCR to assist extracting items without accessibility text, default false.

description.zh_cn: 只读检查当前屏幕，可请求局部高清图与端侧 OCR；不执行点击、滑动或输入。
description.en_us: Inspect the current screen without UI interaction; optionally request a high-resolution region and on-device OCR.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - get_state(reason?, ocr?, x1?, y1?, x2?, y2?): 看不清小字或树中缺少目标时只读检查。区域四个坐标须一起提供，使用全屏 0..1000；ocr=true 请求端侧识字。局部图上的动作仍使用全屏坐标。
prompt_guide.en_us: - get_state(reason?, ocr?, x1?, y1?, x2?, y2?): Inspect unclear text or targets missing from the tree. Supply all four region coordinates together in full-screen 0..1000 coordinates; ocr=true requests on-device OCR. Actions always use full-screen coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 为什么需要重新获取状态，例如上一步操作失败、页面无变化或当前页面不确定。
description.en_us: Why state refresh is needed, such as previous action failed, page did not change, or current page is uncertain.

description.zh_cn: 是否请求端侧文字识别；识别框不是可点击控件。
description.en_us: Request on-device text recognition; OCR boxes are not clickable controls.

description.zh_cn: 检查区域左边缘的全屏 0..1000 坐标。
description.en_us: Region left edge in full-screen 0..1000 coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 检查区域上边缘的全屏 0..1000 坐标。
description.en_us: Region top edge in full-screen 0..1000 coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 检查区域右边缘的全屏 0..1000 坐标。
description.en_us: Region right edge in full-screen 0..1000 coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 检查区域下边缘的全屏 0..1000 坐标。
description.en_us: Region bottom edge in full-screen 0..1000 coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 仅当当前页面或上一轮工具结果直接证明用户目标已经完成时结束。
description.en_us: End only when the current page or previous tool result directly proves the user's goal is complete.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - finished(content?, observation_id?, expected_text?): 仅在当前页面或上一轮工具结果直接证明目标完成时调用；不确定就继续执行下一步。
prompt_guide.en_us: - finished(content?, observation_id?, expected_text?): Call only when the current page or previous tool result directly proves completion; if uncertain, continue with the next action.

description.zh_cn: 给用户的最终完成说明，可为空。
description.en_us: Final completion note for the user. May be empty.

description.zh_cn: 当前页面观测 ID，用于防止在过期页面误完成。
description.en_us: Current page observation ID, preventing completion on expired observations.

description.zh_cn: 当前观测中应匹配的文字；匹配仅证明文字出现。
description.en_us: Text to match in the current observation; matching only proves text presence.

description.zh_cn: 向用户询问或请求手动协助。
description.en_us: Ask the user a question or request manual help.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - info(value): 询问用户或请求用户协助。
prompt_guide.en_us: - info(value): Ask the user for information or manual assistance.

description.zh_cn: 你要问用户的问题或需要用户执行的说明。
description.en_us: Question to ask the user or instructions for the user to perform.

description.zh_cn: 反馈当前上下文与目标不匹配。
description.en_us: Report that the current context does not match the goal.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - feedback(value): 请求上层重新规划。
prompt_guide.en_us: - feedback(value): Ask the upper layer to re-plan.

description.zh_cn: 反馈原因。
description.en_us: Reason for the feedback.

description.zh_cn: 任务无法继续时终止。
description.en_us: Abort when the task cannot continue.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - abort(value?): 在任务无法继续时终止。
prompt_guide.en_us: - abort(value?): Abort when the task cannot continue.

description.zh_cn: 终止任务的原因。
description.en_us: Reason for aborting the task.

description.zh_cn: 让用户在若干选项中选择一个。
description.en_us: Ask the user to choose one option from a list.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - require_user_choice(options, prompt): 让用户做互斥选择。
prompt_guide.en_us: - require_user_choice(options, prompt): Ask the user to make a mutually exclusive choice.

description.zh_cn: 可供用户选择的选项列表。
description.en_us: List of options the user can choose from.

description.zh_cn: 要求用户做选择的提示文案。
description.en_us: Prompt shown to the user when asking for a choice.

description.zh_cn: 让用户确认当前状态后继续。
description.en_us: Ask the user to confirm the current state before continuing.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - require_user_confirmation(prompt): 让用户确认后继续。
prompt_guide.en_us: - require_user_confirmation(prompt): Ask the user to confirm before continuing.

description.zh_cn: 要求用户确认的提示文案。
description.en_us: Prompt asking the user for confirmation.
